name: NiSource
description: NiSource is a regulated gas-and-electric utility holding company serving about 3.8 million customers in six states: natural gas distribution through the Columbia Gas companies (about 2.4 million customers in Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Kentucky and Maryland) and, in northern Indiana, NIPSCO (about 0.9 million gas customers and 0.5 million electric customers). About two-thirds of revenue is gas and one-third electric (computed), but its growth story is electric: NIPSCO is replacing coal by 2028 and, through a generation subsidiary (GenCo, 19.9% sold to Blackstone), is building gas plants to serve contracted Amazon and Alphabet data centers. State regulators set rates to recover cost plus an allowed return (about 9.6% to 10.0% ROE in recent orders).

gics.note: Conventional filing label: GICS Sector 'Utilities' and Sub-Industry 'Multi-Utilities' per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_S%26P_500_companies, read 2026-09-30). That list gives only Sector and Sub-Industry. SEC SIC code 4931 (Electric & Other Services Combined) per EDGAR.

employees.note: 7,668 full-time plus 70 part-time active employees (sum computed); 32% under collective bargaining agreements (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Columbia Operations
businessLines.how: Customers pay state-regulated gas delivery rates each month and the utilities recover the cost of gas; profit is the allowed return on the pipe replacement and system-modernisation investment, partly through riders that recover that capital between rate cases.
businessLines.description: Natural gas distribution by Columbia Gas of Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Kentucky and Maryland to about 2.4 million customers, with about 37,300 miles of distribution main.

revenue.note: Total operating revenues per the segment note (MD&A shows $3,343.3M gross of intersegment; FY2024 $2,716.0M gross) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1111711/000111171126000027/nix-20251231.htm)

businessLines.name: NIPSCO Operations
businessLines.how: Electric and gas customers pay IURC-approved rates monthly with the cost of fuel and purchased power passed through; profit is the allowed return on a fast-growing rate base, and large data-center customers sign long-term contracts under which NIPSCO or GenCo builds dedicated generation and transmission and is paid a regulated return on it.
businessLines.description: Northern Indiana Public Service Company: electric generation, transmission and distribution to about 0.5 million customers in 20 counties (plus customised service to data-center customers) and gas distribution to about 0.9 million customers. Electric 2025 revenue $2,208.9M and gas $1,099.6M.
